scripture.summary: Israel comes to the Jordan at flood stage. The priests carrying the ark step into the water, the river is cut off, and the people cross on dry ground while the priests stand firm in the Jordan.

mission.briefing: The LORD has stopped the Jordan before Israel. Guide Joshua across the opened riverbed to the western bank. Commands run from top to bottom, so place the movement instructions in the correct sequence.
mission.starterCode:
# Cross the Jordan on the opened riverbed.
hero.moveRight()

designNotes: This is the first real ScriptVerse level rather than the earlier engine-integration commission prototype.
Keep Joshua 3:7-17 as the narrative frame: the priests and ark precede the people, the waters are stopped, and Israel crosses on dry ground.
The opened riverbed is deliberately passable while the water north and south of it remains collision geometry.
The first programming task teaches that statements execute in sequence. Two east-west movement calls should carry Joshua from the eastern approach to the western bank.
Later art can show the priests and ark standing in the riverbed without changing the programming objective or collision layout.

engine.integrationNotes: Uses the shared ScriptVerse manifest adapter, renderer, local session pipeline, collision geometry, goals, and manifest-driven hero identity.
